name: White-ankled mouse
desc: White-ankled mouse (Peromyscus pectoralis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 167 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The white-ankled mouse is a species of rodent in the family Cricetidae. It is a species of the genus Peromyscus, a closely related group of New World mice often called "deermice".
